svg.title: Figure 1 · Every image and clip, against the CAD
svg.desc: Every concept-art image and clip with its source render, job and difference from the CAD
svg.text: Figure 1 · Every image and clip, against the CAD
10 images and 2 clips, each from one of the project's Blender renders; 2 of 10 images are close to the CAD, the rest differ as the page records. Read from the page's
Drone shown on a side platform at shoulder height instead of the raised rear dock; feet drawn as
Stowed claws drawn closer to the opening than the CAD places them
The rope ladder hangs flat against the hull over the safety box and leg instead of from the
swing-out davit 0.60 m out: the snag the davit exists to avoid
The pilot wears a fall-arrest harness: a candidate control for the fall-from-height hazard of
emergency egress, suggested by the image, to be evaluated, not evidence
Carries a pallet in its claws while walking: allowed only under the loaded-walking conditions the
lead set (2026-11-12: carry pose, secured load, mass and speed limits all TBD; the CAD has no
carry pose yet); drone on a side platform instead of the rear dock
Rescue crew shown inside the arm's reach: the arms' strike and pinch zone. A scene to prevent,
The red internal release handle reads as a small red cross. The Red Cross emblem is legally
protected; the design should keep that handle unmistakably a handle
8 s image-to-video, frames sheet CL-05-kneel-clip-frames.jpg; see the page for where the motion

Tool: Higgsfield, model gpt_image_2_6, image-to-image, quality high, 2K, 16:9, via the Higgsfield MCP connector.

Generated by tools/figures/art_readme.py from the hand-written concept-art page, the files and the records. AI concept art, not engineering: no dimension, clearance or safety property may be read from these images.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CAD = computer-aided design · CL-nnn = concept layout (cad/params/CL-nn.yaml; CL-01 to CL-05, CL-05 the reference

layout) · I0–I3 = review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MCP = Model Context Protocol, how the AI assistant connects to external tools · TBD = to be
